description:
**CVRP variable-neighborhood descent over tail, chain and single-customer moves.** Use a single depot and homogeneous hard capacity with a complete symmetric matrix. Begin with a greedy Split of the supplied index order.

Run 2-opt* tail exchange, bounded CROSS exchange and interroute relocate on the currently accepted route set. Every operation preserves exact customer coverage and checks the new route loads.

After a strict distance improvement, pass the changed solution back to the first neighborhood. Otherwise advance to the next one. Stop after all neighborhoods fail without a change. This is deterministic descent without a shaking phase.
